observations: Both real models load and move;4K basecolor/normal textures are present, with2K metallic-roughness maps.
Panda likeness is closer than the prior procedural base, but smaller eyes/flatter muzzle and coarse fur/dragon detail remain below the Muse reference.
Panda uses299000 configured native fibers and2400 portable skinned cards. Those counts describe separate representations, not independently counted visible hairs or quality equivalence.

The rigid companion selection is spatial/color authored and expanded25mm; sampled restrained motion keeps it at the right shoulder. It is not an independently controlled dragon and boundary selection is not exhaustive.
Paid panda provider clips are rejected for severe belly/limb/dragon stretching. Four local gestures replace them explicitly; they are not accepted provider animations.

Native contact review: idle is plausible and the small celebration is distinguishable. Crafting/working show hand/head changes but are not clearly recognizable task actions; their meaning remains unaccepted. No visible workpiece or articulated fingers.
No seamless loop or Weft HD compatibility is claimed. Native portraits are opaque; browser cards use glTF MASK, despite the historical manifest has_transparency field referring to the portrait.

state_meaning_acceptance.making_something: not accepted; lacks recognizable object/task interaction
